_: indonesian-ids.json — the number in each Indonesian note's id, pinned to its note: <deck id> → <headword> (a sounds-deck row's key) → N, for the id u_<deck id>_N. A note of these decks is one note with two card templates, so both of a word's cards hang off this id (the English → Indonesian card is <id>~2). Seeded on 2026-11-19 from the eight decks as shipped; applied and extended by indonesian-fix.js and build-indonesian-sounds.js. NEVER delete or renumber a row: a removed note's row moves to _retired, a rename renames the key.
